verdict.rationale: Project-local scope is well documented. Teams can check skills into a working folder, Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the current directory up to the repo root, and repo marketplaces are a distinct team-distribution source. A hands-on probe also installed a skill into `./.agents/skills`. User-global scope is only implied: `$skill-installer` targets "your own local Codex setup" and "local" marketplaces are mentioned, but no global install path or scope selector is shown, and plugin (not skill) installs show no scope choice at all. Missing for 10: a documented user-global install location, an explicit scope-selection option at install time, and plugin-level (not just skill-level) scope control.
